comments.author: @RealLifeFilesDoc
comments.text: The journalistic integrity of this script is outstanding. It is so rare for a travel documentary to showcase the beauty of universal healthcare and a 32-hour workweek [18:24], while also having the courage to expose the devastating housing shortage (410,000 homes) [22:10] and the tragic child care benefit scandal [23:15]. You didn't just paint a utopian postcard; you showed the real, complex mechanics of a nation. Exceptional research! 👏
